notes.title: DLC release
notes.notes:
Hi everyone.

I just published the new DLC of acid nimbus, Skulls and Boxing.

You will find new boxing stage and two traditional stages more to complete.

also includes two new clothes for the protagonist and a new powerful weapon.

I'm sure that if you liked Acid Nimbus, this DLC (Skulls and Boxing) will bring you extra time of good content, beautiful music, and some variety with the boxing gloves.

On the base content, despite the last update, it still needs to be completed with some more details that I have in mind.

You can enjoy yourself fighting an onslaught of hundreds of monsters, as many as you can take!

Greetings, hope you like it, and many thanks for supporting this little game <3

notes.title: great patch
notes.notes:

-New Stage with BOSS

notes.title: More updates
notes.notes:
-5000 points down to 3500 points to unlock new weapons and stages!

-deleted some loud crazy screams from secret monsters, I'm sorry for the possible jumpscares.
